Game Guide
1
Analyze the Export Chart

Study the colorful treemap displaying the mystery country's exports. Each colored block represents a different product category, with larger blocks indicating more significant exports.

2
Submit Your Answer

Enter your best guess in the input field. The autocomplete feature helps you find countries quickly. You have six chances to identify the correct nation.

3
Interpret the Clues

Each incorrect guess reveals valuable information: the geographic distance to the target, an arrow pointing toward the answer, and a percentage showing how close you are.

4
Share Your Achievement

Successfully identify the country or learn from the reveal. Share your results with friends and challenge them to beat your score.

Why Players Love Tradle
Real Economic Data

Puzzles use actual export statistics from countries worldwide, making every game educational.

Global Coverage

Features countries from every continent, expanding your knowledge of world geography and trade.

Fresh Daily Puzzles

Return each day for a brand new challenge. Every puzzle presents unique exports to analyze.

Progress Tracking

Monitor your improvement with detailed statistics showing games played, win rates, and streaks.

About Tradle

Tradle transforms learning about international commerce into an exciting daily challenge. By visualizing actual export data, players develop an intuitive understanding of global trade patterns. Whether you're a student of economics, a geography enthusiast, or simply love brain teasers, Tradle offers an engaging way to discover which nations produce everything from semiconductors to soybeans. The game rewards both knowledge and deductive reasoning, as geographic clues help narrow down possibilities even when specific exports seem unfamiliar.

Game Mechanics

Tradle employs a sophisticated hint system designed to guide you toward the answer. After submitting a guess, you receive three pieces of information: the distance between your guess and the target country (in kilometers or miles), an arrow indicating the direction to travel, and a proximity percentage showing how close geographically you are to the answer. Higher percentages mean you're getting warmer! The visual export chart uses color-coded categories matching international trade classifications, helping you recognize patterns across different economies.

Common Questions
What distinguishes Tradle from similar games?

Tradle uniquely focuses on economic data rather than flags, capitals, or outlines. By analyzing export products, you learn about real-world industries, natural resources, and manufacturing capabilities of different nations.

When does the daily puzzle reset?

A new puzzle becomes available at midnight in your local timezone. Everyone worldwide receives the same puzzle each day, enabling friendly competition and score comparisons.

Can I play more than once per day?

The daily challenge limits you to one attempt, but Practice Mode offers unlimited puzzles. Use it to sharpen your skills between daily challenges or explore countries at your own pace.

Does Tradle work on mobile devices?

Absolutely! Tradle features responsive design that adapts perfectly to smartphones, tablets, and desktop computers. Enjoy the same great experience on any screen size.
